contract.instructions:
CONTRACT-ONLY fleshing-out; do not implement.
Source anchors: plan §7.5 row line 2132 (execute dispatch CLI with scope gate1-target-bound, next generator R1.6; output target-bound card set); §7.4 lines 2015-2071 (exact CLI shape: snapshot-tree, build with all named arguments, verify; manifest shape with schemaVersion ranking_v3_dispatch_cards_v2, planSha256, baselineCommit, dispatchCommit, dispatchTreeSha256, qualificationTargetSha256, contractSealSha256, taskGraphSha256); §1.1 bootstrap order (R1.0B generates target-bound cards for R1.T1, R1.T2, R1.1-R1.5, R1.6 after R1.0); §1.4 dispatch authority; §6.4A lines 1503-1510; §8.1 Gate-0 acceptance (R1.0B generates target-bound Gate-1 cards plus the R1.6 boundary-generator card).
Prerequisite edges (exact prerequisite table, plan line 1732): R1.0B: R1.0, R0.1B.
focused_command is the plan-specified §7.4 command; it depends on R0.1V-owned scripts/verify-ranking-v3-rebase.mjs and R0.1B-owned scripts/ranking-v3-dispatch-cards.mjs, neither of which exists at round_base, so it is unverifiable-at-base. affected_command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (package.json line 26).
This is an execution card, not a code-change card: verification uses the §7.6 unmet-precondition/validating-assertion pattern (card-set manifest includes target scope plus next generator and binds the current dispatch tree); no first-RED test is required.
The next generator R1.6 is nondispatchable until R1.5's gate receipt exists (sealed graph/gate receipts); R1.0B does not generate cards for tasks whose output digests do not exist yet. The dispatch tree is bound through $DISPATCH_COMMIT (integration HEAD named by the preceding gate receipt).
